information.description:
Built for executives who have outlived their first body. It looks like you on your best day and takes an assassin's bullet without creasing the suit. The board's logic is simple: thirty years of experience is the asset, so protect it.

Cost: 16,500eb (Very Expensive)
Humanity Loss: 50 (15d6)
Frame: Sigma (12): BODY 12
Eyes: Cybereye ×2
Base chrome (no HL): FBC Gemini Sculpt
Chrome: AudioVox, Hidden Holster, ProxiShield ×2, Self-ICE ×3, Subdermal Armor, Voice Stress Analyzer

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.

Item Compendium (2070) • Full Body Conversions
